name: seo-programmatic-quality-gate
summary: Block unsafe scaled SEO recommendations until samples, information gain, business purpose, uniqueness, evidence, and controls are verified.
inputs: project/template family/page range/data source/markets/query evidence/business purpose/owners/launch-prune scope
external_reads: approved provider, page, analytics, catalog, crawl, and first-party evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live provider, page, analytics, catalog, or crawl reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: generation, publishing, template, CMS, code, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: representative sample, template family, data source, page range, purpose, evidence, information gain, uniqueness, risk, owner, and recheck are explicit
missing samples, facts, purpose, information gain, controls, or rollback block
verdict is PASS, PASS_WITH_CONDITIONS, BLOCK, or DEFERRED
no pages are generated or published
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify no scaled pages were generated or published
verify blocked evidence and conditions are visible
verify no template, CMS, code, or production mutation occurred
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
